file_insights.changes_summary: Added lazy loading and cache invalidation to BM25Index
key_additions: Lazy cache loading in index() method
Cache save logic after index rebuild

patterns_discovered.description: Cache is loaded only if paths match exactly; otherwise, index is rebuilt
patterns_discovered.implementation: Exact path comparison (cached_paths == paths) before using cache

patterns_discovered.description: Cache failures don't break functionality; system falls back to rebuilding
patterns_discovered.implementation: Try-except blocks around cache operations with fallthrough logic

patterns_discovered.description: Multiple log levels (debug for success/misses, warning for errors) guide troubleshooting
patterns_discovered.implementation: logger.debug for cache hits/misses, logger.warning for failures

patterns_discovered.description: Persistence logic delegated to BM25Persistence class

gotchas_discovered.description: Cache is only valid if ALL paths match exactly; any change invalidates cache
gotchas_discovered.impact: May result in unexpected rebuilds if path representation changes (e.g., Path normalization)

gotchas_discovered.description: Cache load failures are caught broadly (OSError, Exception) and logged at debug level
gotchas_discovered.impact: Subtle issues in BM25Persistence could go unnoticed in production

gotchas_discovered.description: Caching adds dependency on BM25Persistence but is optional at runtime
gotchas_discovered.impact: Cache_path=None path must work correctly; ensures backward compatibility but adds code paths

key_achievements: Implemented lazy loading from disk cache
Added automatic cache invalidation on path changes
Maintained backward compatibility with optional caching
Proper error handling for all cache operations
approach_outcome.scope_completed: Full subtask completed in single attempt without rework

recommendations.recommendation: Add cache hit/miss metrics for performance tracking
recommendations.rationale: Cannot assess caching effectiveness without visibility into usage
Prevents deserialization errors if BM25Okapi format changes

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding cache_valid() method to check cache state without loading
recommendations.rationale: Allows callers to decide whether to invalidate proactively

recommendations.recommendation: Document expected cache size and suggest cleanup strategy for old caches
recommendations.rationale: Disk space management may be concern for large-scale deployments

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding cache statistics (size, age, documents count) for debugging
